title: Warm Flaky Ethiopian Beef Gored Gored
description: A malty, flaky, and quick-fix Ethiopian dish featuring chicken stock concentrate and kombu-cold-extract, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of flavors and textures creates a unique and delicious experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken stock concentrate, kombu-cold-extract, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spoon the beef mixture onto one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little bit of oil and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the gored gored in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
